title.instructions:
Write the title in Japanese, even if the user prompt is in English.
An actionable task label: requested operation + concrete target + strongest distinguishing anchor (max 80 characters).
Keep explicit identifiers such as PR or issue numbers, file paths, packages, components, commands, and quoted names as they are when they distinguish the task.
Keep it short, but never drop a part needed to understand or distinguish the task.
Example: "PR #2638 の Playwright テストをリファクタ".
